items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itaquaquecetuba (SP) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through electronic competitive bidding (concorrência), with an estimated value of about R$ 3,525,969.47; proposals close Dec 2, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
